subject: Decision Making
title: Conditions for Crowd Wisdom
description: A micro-lesson that makes Conditions for Crowd Wisdom usable.

hook.text: Crowds are wise only under specific conditions. Remove any one, and the crowd becomes a mob.

buildup.text: James Surowiecki identified four conditions: diversity of opinion, independence, decentralization.

discovery.text: Diversity brings different information. Independence prevents copying. Decentralization avoids top-down distortion.

twist.text: Social media violates all four conditions. People see same sources, copy influencers.

climax.text: Crowd wisdom is fragile. The conditions are demanding. Most real crowds do not meet them.

quiz.question: What condition is NOT required for crowd wisdom?
